justification: Changes what is served: a DCP number rule is shown only when its quote is proven word for word on its cited PDF page. Enforced by a database trigger (migration 120) because every reader of dcp_setback_controls that shows a number already hides needs_review rows (conveyancing_db.fetch_dcp_setbacks, granny_flat, dcp_controls_api, structured-controls, canibuildit/check, tod/parking-rates, parking-rate-selection). Also corrects two published counts that the 2026-10-29 withholding (641 rows) made overstated.

falsifiable_check.command: PYTEST_REAL_DB=1 DATABASE_URL=... python -m pytest tests/test_dcp_quote_status.py -o addopts=
falsifiable_check.fails_when: an unproven row (quote_status NULL/not_found/wrong_page/no_source) keeps needs_review=false, a release without proof sticks, or editing the quote/page keeps an old proof
falsifiable_check.observed_red: First trigger-test run inserted a row and the failing row already showed needs_review=t with the new reason (trigger fired); 22 passed after fixing the test row. Without migration 120 applied to the temp table, test_an_unproven_row_is_not_served asserts needs_review is True and would fail on the inserted False.

pre_impl.existing_data: dcp_setback_controls: 1,273 rows, 1,136 current, 235 served (2026-10-29). Existing trigger dcp_setback_controls_clear_citation_status (same pattern, other column). 67 current rows have no active registry chapter -> no_source.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: citation_status was expected to be reusable; it records whether the CLAUSE NUMBER is printed, not the quote, so a new column was needed. 7 chapter_keys are shared across councils; the 2026-10-29 evidence script looked up by chapter_key alone, so the checker joins on chapter_key AND council (0 current rows mismatch).
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: New column + checker + trigger; no reader changed. Matching identical to the the 2026-10-29 evidence script run that measured the 235.
pre_impl.external_source_error: R2 fetch or pypdf failure -> page texts None -> classify returns no_source -> row held. A wrong or missing PDF can only lower a verdict, never produce 'verbatim'.
pre_impl.frontend_type: No frontend type changes. Readers see the same row shape; held rows are already excluded by their needs_review filter. coverage.ts constants stay number/string literals.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Fails closed and visibly: a rule that cannot be proven disappears from the page (fewer rules shown), never a summary shown as the council's words. Worst case (120 applied before stamping) = served count 0, caught by verify_coverage_stats and the served-count query.

functions.name: classify
functions.input: quote text, list of raw page texts (or None), cited pdf_page
functions.output: one of four strings: verbatim (on the cited page or across its page break), wrong_page, not_found, no_source
functions.if_none: any of quote, pages or pdf_page missing or empty returns no_source, so the row stays held

functions.name: changed
functions.input: list of (row id, stored quote_status) pairs and a dict mapping row id to the new verdict
functions.output: list of (row id, new verdict) for only the rows whose verdict changed, so unchanged rows are not rewritten

queries.where_clause: is_current, optional lga; registry joined on chapter_key AND council AND is_active
queries.if_wrong: a wrong PDF can only lower a verdict (exact match required), never raise one

break_it.scenario: Migration 120 applied before the checker stamps the 235.
break_it.what_happens: Every served rule is hidden (fail closed, visible as served count 0). Documented at the top of 120; apply order is 119 -> checker --apply -> 120.
break_it.repro: python scripts/run_migration.py migrations/120_setback_serve_only_verbatim.sql before the checker, then: select count(*) from dcp_setback_controls where is_current and needs_review is not true  -> 0
break_it.how: Apply order written at the top of migration 120 and in post_merge.db_reset; served count is checked after each step.

break_it.scenario: Someone fixes pdf_page and re-writes quote_status='verbatim' in the same UPDATE.
break_it.what_happens: Proof wiped, row held until the checker re-proves the new page (test_restating_an_old_proof_with_a_new_page_does_not_count).
break_it.repro: PYTEST_REAL_DB=1 python -m pytest tests/test_dcp_quote_status.py -o addopts= -k restating
break_it.how: Covered by test_restating_an_old_proof_with_a_new_page_does_not_count; the checker re-proves the new page.

break_it.scenario: A pipeline inserts a new row with needs_review=false.
break_it.what_happens: Held with reason 'quote not proven ... (unchecked)' until the checker proves it and a person releases it.
break_it.repro: PYTEST_REAL_DB=1 python -m pytest tests/test_dcp_quote_status.py -o addopts= -k unproven
break_it.how: Trigger holds it on insert; covered by test_an_unproven_row_is_not_served (proof NULL case).

break_it.scenario: A stored quote differs from the PDF by one digit (the May 2026 summaries).
break_it.what_happens: Classified not_found and held, because only an exact normalised match is ever verbatim.
break_it.repro: PYTEST_REAL_DB=1 python -m pytest tests/test_dcp_quote_status.py -o addopts= -k one_changed_number
break_it.how: Exact normalised match only; covered by test_one_changed_number_is_not_found.

break_it.scenario: Someone releases a held row by hand (needs_review=false) without a proof.
break_it.what_happens: Trigger sets needs_review back to true with the reason.
break_it.repro: PYTEST_REAL_DB=1 python -m pytest tests/test_dcp_quote_status.py -o addopts= -k releasing
break_it.how: Trigger re-holds it; covered by test_releasing_an_unproven_row_is_undone.

break_it.scenario: The quote is edited after it was proven.
break_it.what_happens: The trigger wipes the proof to NULL and the row is held until re-proven.
break_it.repro: PYTEST_REAL_DB=1 python -m pytest tests/test_dcp_quote_status.py -o addopts= -k changing_the_quote
break_it.how: Trigger wipes the proof; covered by test_changing_the_quote_wipes_the_proof_and_hides_the_row.

post_merge.db_reset: Order on prod: run_migration 119 -> dcp_quote_status.py (dry run shows 235 verbatim) -> --apply (writes backup) -> run_migration 120 -> served count still 235. Undo 120: DROP TRIGGER dcp_setback_hold_unproven_quote ON dcp_setback_controls.
post_merge.secrets: none added; uses existing DATABASE_URL and R2_* from .env
post_merge.manual_verify: select count(*) from dcp_setback_controls where is_current and needs_review is not true -> 235 after 120; open one address page and see only proven rules.
